summary.content:
Today's selection covers 81 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 53 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI changes deal with US military after backlash
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Dark Reading Confidential: This Threat Hunter Helped Cops Bust Up An African Cybercrime Syndicate
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, BBC Technology, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 44 articles published in the last 24 hours
